sidebar.awaitingPrivate: ⚠ A Bot is waiting in private chat

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDesc: Web UI language. Server system prompts follow the OSA_LOCALE env var.

desc.models: Which models each Bot uses. Add a provider first, then pick a model per role.
desc.usage: How much you spent: by day, role, and task.
desc.limits: Keep tasks from running too long or spending too much. Saves on blur.
desc.triggers: All Bot routines at a glance.

daily_token_budget: No new tasks after the cap; resets next day
worker_max_steps: One step = one model call. Computer work needs more
heavy: Same question to several workers then merge. More = broader but costlier (1–8)

onboarding.welcomeOkBody: Bots think and work with large models. A model is ready — next, set up your Bot and connect a useful app.
onboarding.modelReady: Used for chat and background tasks
onboarding.changeHint: To switch providers (OpenAI, Qwen, Kimi…), click Change. You can also edit later in Settings → Models.
onboarding.welcomeNeedTitle: Welcome! Connect a large model first
onboarding.welcomeNeedBody: Bots think and work with large models. Pick a provider you have an account with and paste its API key — stored encrypted on your server. Unsure? DeepSeek is cheap and strong for Chinese; other OpenAI-compatible APIs work too.
onboarding.skipStep: Skip for now (Bot cannot reply yet)
onboarding.pickModelBody: Chat, background work, review and filtering all start with this model; you can change each later in Settings → Models. Bots need vision to use the computer — pick a model that can see images.
onboarding.checkKey: Go back and check the API key and base URL.
onboarding.visionNo: Cannot see images — Bot cannot use the computer
onboarding.meetBotBody: A Bot is ready. Name it and say what you mainly want help with; you can also leave it blank and explain in chat.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.mainJobPh: e.g. morning AI news digest; watch a few GitHub repos; draft emails before sending
onboarding.orTemplateHint: Templates come with skills and routines. {{name}} stays too.
onboarding.appsTitle: Let your Bot use your apps
onboarding.appsBody: Once connected, the Bot can take notes, research, organize files, send mail. Try one common app; add more later under Apps in the sidebar.
onboarding.marketHint: The market has {{count}} apps, and any MCP server works too:
onboarding.noApps: None yet — connect later under Apps
onboarding.ex1: What AI news is worth watching today? Pick 5 with links
onboarding.ex2: Every weekday at 9am, send me the top 5 Hacker News stories
onboarding.mobileHint: Use it on your phone too: connect a chat app to talk on Telegram, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, or Discord.

chat.handHint: Take over the computer, then click Hand back so the Bot can continue.
chat.bgExpire: · Background — deny if not confirmed by {{time}}

composer.listening: Listening… tap ■ when done, then send
composer.busy: {{name}} is replying… you can keep sending
composer.hintGroup: Enter send · Shift+Enter newline · @ Bot or app · @everyone
composer.hintBot: Enter send · Shift+Enter newline · @ app · / skill

连接中…第一次要下载，可能要一两分钟: Connecting… first download may take 1–2 min
已保存在保险库，留空则不修改: In vault; leave blank to keep
按意思找页面，比如“上次做的竞品对比”: Search pages by meaning, e.g. “last competitor comparison”
Bot 本身：回复你、决定要不要派任务。要看电脑屏幕，得选能看图的。: The Bot: replies and dispatches. Needs vision to see the screen.
真正干活的：操作电脑、调用应用、查资料。也要能看图。: Worker: drives computer, apps, research. Needs vision too.
Heavy 模式里，把几个并行任务的结果汇总成一份。: In Heavy mode, merge several parallel results.
判断定时任务收到的事件要不要处理、把导入的记忆拆成条目。便宜的就行。: Decide if routine events need action; split imported memories. A cheap model is fine.
提供模型的平台。填好地址和 API Key 就能用它的模型，密钥加密存在保险库里: Model platforms. Add URL + API key; secrets stay encrypted in the vault.
常做的事选便宜、快的，难的选强的。改了马上生效，点“测试”会真的调一次。: Everyday work: cheap/fast; hard work: strong. Changes apply immediately; Test makes a real call.
Bot 找以前的记忆和页面时用。不选也能按关键词找（中文按两个字一组）；选一个: Used when the Bot looks up past notes/pages. Keywords work without it; embeddings find similar phrasing.
本机的一般不用填: Local setups usually leave this blank
请求没报错，但模型没认出测试图片的颜色: Request OK but model missed the test image color
思考模式：不是所有模型都支持，改了点“测试”确认一下: Thinking mode: not all models support it — Test after changing
搜索，或者直接填模型名字: Search, or type a model name
没认出 embedding 模型，可以在上面直接填名字: Embedding model not detected — type the name above
没有列出模型，可以在上面直接填名字: No models listed — type the name above
重新配对后，原来的私聊就不能再用了。继续？: Re-pairing invalidates the old private chat. Continue?
服务器在国内的话，要设置 HTTPS_PROXY 才连得上 Telegram。: Servers in China need HTTPS_PROXY for Telegram.
还差一步：在 Telegram 里打开这个机器人，把配对码发给它。: One more step: open the bot in Telegram and send the pairing code.
密钥加密存在你自己的服务器上。: Secrets stay encrypted on your server.
还差一步：在飞书里打开这个机器人，把配对码发给它。: One more step: open the bot in Feishu and send the pairing code.
钉钉的卡片按钮要另建模板，确认请求改成点链接（或回复“允许 #编号”）。: DingTalk card buttons need a template; confirm via link (or reply “allow #id”).
还差一步：在钉钉里搜索这个机器人，打开单聊，把配对码发给它。: One more step: find the bot in DingTalk, open a DM, send the pairing code.
同一个机器人只能连一处，改成回调模式后这里就断了。: One bot can only connect once; switching to callback mode disconnects here.
还差一步：在企业微信里找到这个机器人，单聊发配对码给它。: One more step: find the bot in WeCom and DM the pairing code.
服务器在国内的话，要设置 HTTPS_PROXY 才连得上 Discord。: Servers in China need HTTPS_PROXY for Discord.
还差两步：先把机器人加到你自己的服务器，再私信它配对码。: Two more steps: add the bot to your server, then DM the pairing code.
① 把机器人加到你的服务器: ① Add the bot to your server
② 打开机器人，发私信: ② Open the bot and send a DM
用这个备份替换这台的全部数据？正在做的任务会被打断。原来的数据库会在服务器上留一: Replace all data on this machine with the backup? Running tasks stop. The old DB stays on the server.
服务没有自动起来：手动启动它，启动时会换上备份。: Service did not come back — start it manually; it will load the backup.
可以留空，直接在对话里交代。这里写的内容每次都会告诉 Bot。: Can be blank — explain in chat. This text is sent to the Bot every turn.
放弃这段录制？录到的操作不会保存。: Discard this recording? Captured actions will not be saved.
输入文字发到电脑（先在画面上点一下输入框）: Type to the computer (click an input on screen first)
例如：用户希望回答先给结论，再给细节: e.g. user wants conclusions first, then details
在电脑上做一遍，Bot 整理成技能: Do it once on the computer; the Bot turns it into a skill
从文件或分享链接装一个技能: Install a skill from a file or share link
文件太大了，不像是一个技能: File too large to be a skill
别人分享的 …/skill/… 链接，或 GitHub 上的 SKILL.md: A shared …/skill/… link, or a GitHub SKILL.md
步骤、要用的网站或应用、输出格式……: Steps, sites/apps to use, output format…
看这次运行每一步做了什么: See each step of this run
会出现在网址里，例如 github: Appears in the URL, e.g. github
例如：整理今天 AI 领域的 5 条新闻，附链接: e.g. summarize 5 AI stories today with links
文件太大了，不像是一个 Bot 模板: File too large to be a Bot template
models.dev 里没有找到这个模型的单价，费用按 0 计: No unit price on models.dev; counted as 0

没有通知权限，请在浏览器或系统设置里允许这个网站发通知: Notifications blocked — allow this site in browser/system settings
已发出，几秒内应该收到: Sent — you should get it in a few seconds
请换用 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。: Please use Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari.
命中的操作一定弹确认卡片: Matching actions always show an approval card
命中的操作直接执行。确认卡片上点“总是允许”会加到这里: Matching actions run immediately. Always allow adds a rule here
看这个任务每一步做了什么: See each step of this task
用户表示处理不了: User said they cannot handle it
每天早上 9 点给我整理 AI 领域的重要新闻: Every morning at 9, summarize important AI news for me
帮我调研一下自部署 SearxNG 的最佳实践: Research best practices for self-hosting SearxNG
你能做哪些事？先介绍一下你的能力: What can you do? Introduce your capabilities

没有麦克风权限，请在浏览器设置里允许: Microphone blocked — allow in browser settings
语音识别连不上服务（Chrome 要能访问 Google 的语音服务，Safar: Speech recognition unreachable (Chrome needs Google Speech; Safari works directly)

Bot 做好的报告、清单、网页会存在这里。在对话里说“把结果做成页面”，或者在任: Reports, lists, and pages the Bot makes land here. Say “save as a page” in chat, or tap “Save as page” under a task result.
Bot 用哪些大模型。先添加模型服务，再给每项工作选一个模型。: Which models the Bot uses. Add a provider first, then pick a model per role.
Bot 靠大模型思考和干活。模型已经接好了，下面两步建好你的 Bot、连上常用的: The Bot thinks with a large model. Models are ready — next: create your Bot and connect everyday apps.
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行 · @ 指定 Bot 或应用: Enter send · Shift+Enter newline · @ Bot or app · @everyone
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行 · @ 指定应用 · / 调: Enter send · Shift+Enter newline · @ app · / skill
Heavy 模式同时跑几个任务: Heavy mode runs several workers at once
iPhone / iPad：先在 Safari 里点“分享 → 添加到主屏幕”，: iPhone/iPad: in Safari tap Share → Add to Home Screen, open from there, then enable here.
· 任何拿到链接的人都能看: · Anyone with the link can view
“写操作”指新建、修改、删除、发送这类会改东西的操作。单个工具的规则在 设置 →: “Write” means create/edit/delete/send. Per-tool rules: Settings → Approval rules.
“权限管理”里开通：读取用户发给机器人的单聊消息、以应用的身份发消息、获取与上传: In Permissions, enable: read DMs to the bot, send as the app, get/upload images or files (optional: reactions for “typing”).
“版本管理与发布”里创建版本并发布，然后在飞书里打开机器人，发送配对码: In Versioning & release, create and publish; open the bot in Feishu and send the pairing code.
“版本管理与发布”里发布应用；在钉钉里搜索机器人的名字，打开单聊，发送配对码: In Versioning & release, publish; in DingTalk search the bot name, open a DM, send the pairing code.
● 正在录制演示，在右栏“电脑”里操作，做完点“完成”。: ● Recording a demo — use the Computer panel on the right, then tap Done.
⚠ 有 Bot 等你确认（在私聊里）: ⚠ A Bot awaits your approval (in DM)
。两类规则都命中时，“先问我”优先。: . If both rule types match, “ask me” wins.
。先在上面添加对应的服务。: . Add the matching provider above first.
。接手电脑处理完后点“交还”，Bot 会接着做。: . After you finish on the computer, tap Hand back and the Bot continues.
一步 = 一次模型调用。电脑操作一步一个动作，要多给一些: One step = one model call. Computer actions are one move per step — give more room.
上传之前导出的 .osabak 文件，先解密检查，给你看里面有什么，确认后才替换: Upload a previously exported .osabak; we decrypt, show contents, and replace only after you confirm.
上传附件（存到电脑的 uploads 目录）: Attach files (saved to the computer’s uploads folder)
不能看图，Bot 用不了电脑: Can’t see images — Bot can’t use the computer
今天 AI 领域有什么值得关注的新闻？挑 5 条，附上链接: What AI news is worth watching today? Pick 5 with links
从现成的模板开始（带好技能和定时任务），或者建一个空白的。: Start from a ready template (skills + routines) or create a blank one.
使用长连接接收事件: Receive events over a long connection
先跳过这一步（Bot 暂时没法回复）: Skip this step (Bot can’t reply yet)
共享后其他 Bot 也会知道这一条。: Once shared, other Bots will know this too.
单价是每百万 token 的输入 / 输出价，: Unit price is input/output per million tokens,
原来那台如果还开着，记得停掉，不然定时任务会跑两遍。: If the old instance is still up, stop it or routines will run twice.
发到群里，@ 指定 Bot: Post in the group, @ a Bot
可以指定用哪个。: you can pick which one to use.
同一个问题交给几个后台任务分头做，再汇总。越多越全面，也越贵（1–8）: Hand the same question to several background workers, then merge. More is broader and costlier (1–8).
后台任务每一步做了什么都记在这里。正在做的实时更新，做完的也能点开回看。: Every background-task step is logged here. Live while running; open later to review.
回上一步检查 API Key 和地址。: Go back and check the API key and URL.
在企业微信里找到这个机器人，发消息给它（单聊），把配对码发过去: In WeCom find this bot, DM it, and send the pairing code
在手机上也能用：连上聊天软件，就能在 Telegram、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、D: Use on your phone: connect a chat app to talk on Telegram/Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/Discord.
备份里有你所有的密钥（应用的 token、邮箱授权码、聊天软件的机器人密钥），所: The backup holds all secrets (app tokens, mail codes, chat bot keys), so set a passphrase; restore needs the same one.
复制这个页面的链接，在侧栏 ＋ →: Copy this page’s link; in the sidebar ＋ →
复制这个页面的链接，在右栏“技能”里点: Copy this page’s link; in the Skills panel tap
大多数操作直接执行；写操作默认先问你。规则按工具全名匹配，可以用: Most actions run directly; writes ask first by default. Rules match full tool names; you can use
超过以后不再派新的任务，第二天恢复: Over budget: no new tasks until tomorrow
界面显示语言。改完立即生效，也会同步给服务器（提示词与应用目录）。: UI language. Applies immediately and syncs to the server (prompts + catalog).
每个工作日早上 9 点，把 Hacker News 上最热的 5 条整理给我: Every weekday at 9am, summarize the top 5 Hacker News stories for me
连上后会给你一个配对码，在 Telegram 里发给你的机器人就能用了: After connecting you get a pair code; send it to your Telegram bot to use it
起个名字，在对话里交代它做什么: Name it, then tell it what to do in chat
里粘贴到“从别人分享的模板装”；或者下载文件后选择它。装之前会先给你看一遍。: paste into “Install from a shared template”; or download the file and pick it. You’ll preview before install.
想换成别的服务（OpenAI、通义千问、Kimi……），点“换一个”。以后在 设: To switch providers (OpenAI, Tongyi, Kimi…), click “Switch”. You can also change later under Settings → Models.
还没连，以后在侧栏“应用”里连: Not connected yet; later connect under sidebar “Apps”
还没有。比如你对它做事方式的要求。: None yet. E.g. how you want it to work.
连上后点“把机器人加到你的服务器”，选一个你自己的服务器（没有就先建一个）。Di: After connecting, click “Add bot to your server”, pick your server (create one if needed). Discord only allows DMs from the same server
，口令放在环境变量: , put the passphrase in an env var
把“凭证与基础信息”里的 Client ID 和 Client Secret 填: Fill Client ID and Client Secret from “Credentials & basics” below, then Connect
连上后回到后台的“事件与回调”：事件配置选: After connecting, open “Events & callbacks”: event config set to
这个任务是在更新之前做的，没有记下过程。: This task ran before the update; no process was recorded.
技能是一个 Markdown 文件（开头写 name 和 description: A skill is a Markdown file (name and description at the top), like Claude’s SKILL.md. After import you preview; it applies only when saved.
选一个服务商。列表里没有的选“其他”，任何兼容 OpenAI 接口的都能用。: Pick a provider. If it’s missing, choose “Other”; any OpenAI-compatible API works.
换成账号里已有的另一台电脑: Switch to another computer already in the account
手机上可以把它当应用用：Safari 点“分享 → 添加到主屏幕”，Chrome: On phone use it as an app: Safari Share → Add to Home Screen; Chrome menu → Add to Home Screen / Install app.
粘贴进去；或者下载文件后选择它。导入时会先给你看一遍。: Paste it, or download the file and pick it. Imports show a preview first.
比如：每天早上整理 AI 领域的新闻；盯着我关注的几个 GitHub 项目；回邮: E.g. summarize AI news each morning; watch a few GitHub repos; show email drafts before sending
把这台的全部数据打成一个加密文件：换机器、从本机搬到服务器时，在新的那台上传它就: Pack all data on this machine into an encrypted file; on a new host upload it to continue.
把名字、头像、职责、技能、定时任务打包，别人装上就得到一个一样的 Bot。对话、: Pack name, avatar, role, skills, and schedules; others get the same Bot. Chat, memory, library, and app secrets are not included.
防止任务跑太久、花太多。改完离开输入框就保存。: Keep tasks from running too long or costing too much. Blur to save.
花了多少钱：按天、按用途、按任务统计。: Spend: by day, purpose, and task.
所有 Bot 共享（适合名字、时区这类关于你的基本事实）: Shared by all Bots (good for name, timezone, basic facts about you)
装好就开始定时运行（不勾的话先暂停，在右栏“定时”里开启）: Start on a schedule after install (uncheck to pause; enable under right “Schedule”)
打开机器人的配置页面，开启: Open the bot config page, enable
页面点 Reset Token，把 token 贴到下面，点连接（不用打开任何: page click Reset Token, paste the token below, then Connect (no Privileged Gateway Intents needed)
推送需要 https 访问（本机 localhost 也行）。手机上建议用 Ta: Push needs https (localhost works). On phones prefer a Tailscale https URL; see docs “Remote access”.
